about: Lumora's macro library. Each macro imports into a free slot of the Macros pool. {self} in a line becomes the macro's own number.

macros.name: Save show
macros.description: Saves the show to its file (Save as… when it has none yet).

macros.name: Clear all
macros.description: Empties the programmer and the selection.

macros.name: Blackout
macros.description: Blackout on, or off again.

macros.name: Highlight
macros.description: Highlight on, or off again.

macros.name: Stop every macro
macros.description: Stops every running macro.

macros.name: Undo
macros.description: Takes back the last command or edit.

macros.name: Programmer fade 2 s
macros.description: Values set by hand fade in over 2 seconds instead of jumping.

macros.name: Programmer fade off
macros.description: Values set by hand jump again.

macros.name: Next fixture
macros.description: Steps through the selection one fixture at a time.

macros.name: Previous fixture
macros.description: Steps back through the selection one fixture at a time.

macros.name: Whole selection
macros.description: Back to the whole selection after Next or Prev.

macros.name: Spread every 2
macros.description: Every second fixture of the selection: odd, then even with Next.

macros.name: Spread off
macros.description: Back to no spread.

macros.name: Spread from the pool
macros.description: Asks for a spread's number and turns it on.

macros.name: Selection at full
macros.description: The selected fixtures at full.

macros.name: Selection out
macros.description: The selected fixtures at 0.

macros.name: Dimmer +10
macros.description: Each selected fixture 10 % brighter than it is.

macros.name: Dimmer -10
macros.description: Each selected fixture 10 % darker than it is.

macros.name: Set a level
macros.description: Asks for a level once and keeps it as $level, then sets the selection to it. Later lines and commands can use $level too.

macros.name: Pan left 10°
macros.description: Each selected fixture 10° left of where it points now.

macros.name: Pan right 10°
macros.description: Each selected fixture 10° right of where it points now.

macros.name: Tilt up 10°
macros.description: Each selected fixture 10° up from where it points now.

macros.name: Tilt down 10°
macros.description: Each selected fixture 10° down from where it points now.

macros.name: Nudge pan
macros.description: Asks how far, then pans each selected fixture that far from where it is (-15 goes the other way).

lines.command: Pan +(Pan by how many degrees? -15 goes the other way)

macros.name: Nudge tilt
macros.description: Asks how far, then tilts each selected fixture that far from where it is (-15 goes the other way).

lines.command: Tilt +(Tilt by how many degrees? -15 goes the other way)

macros.name: Nudge pan and tilt
macros.description: Asks for both, then moves each selected fixture that far from where it points.

macros.name: Center
macros.description: Pan and tilt of the selection to 0: straight out.

macros.name: Pan sweep
macros.description: Swings the selection 30° right and back every 2 seconds, from where it points, until stopped (right-click → Stop, or Off Macro). With the programmer fade on, it moves smoothly.

macros.name: Tilt nod
macros.description: Nods the selection 15° up and back every 1.5 seconds, from where it points, until stopped.

macros.name: Go on an executor
macros.description: Asks for an executor and presses Go on it.

macros.name: Load a cue
macros.description: Asks for an executor and a cue: the next Go there fires that cue.

macros.name: Store next cue
macros.description: Asks for a sequence and stores the programmer in it as its next cue.
